problem_register_binding.summary: ArtifactDetail fired artifact, deployments, audit, and lineage reads concurrently on mount; when GET /bff/artifacts/:id returned 404 (e.g. art_stg001_v320 during hosted crawl), the lineage, deployments, and audit reads still executed and a slow /bff/lineage response failed the route.

AC1_gate_secondary_reads_on_found_artifa.implementation: In src/management/pages/ArtifactDetail.tsx, tracked the route entityId that resolved the current artifact instance and gated the secondary useEffect on const loadedId = isLoadedForRoute ? id : undefined (following the execute-plans #1111 loadedId pattern on RebalanceDetail, DeploymentDetail, and EvolutionDetail). When GET /bff/artifacts/:id is still pending, returns 404, or fails with an error, loadedId remains undefined, no /bff/lineage, /bff/deployments, or /bff/audit request is sent, and the existing not-found or error EmptyState renders unchanged.
tests: src/management/pages/ArtifactDetail.test.tsx > ArtifactDetail load states > sends zero lineage, deployments, and audit requests when GET /bff/artifacts/:id returns 404 or fails

src/management/pages/ArtifactDetail.test.tsx > ArtifactDetail load states > starts lineage, deployments, and audit reads only after the artifact read resolves, sends exactly one lineage read for a found artifact, and cancels previous reads when route id changes

AC2_single_lineage_read_and_route_change.implementation: For a found artifact, loadedId transitions to id once, sending managementConsoleReads.lineage(loadedId) (GET /bff/lineage?root_id=<id>), bffV1.deployments.list(), and bffV1.audit.list() once. The lineage tab keeps its loading, empty, unavailable, and graph states unchanged. When the route :id changes, loadedId immediately clears until the new route's artifact resolves, running the effect cleanup (cancelled = true) to ignore in-flight responses from the previous route id.
